Race Recap THREE CHAMPIONSHIP ORGANIZATIONS. ONE EPIC RACE. MARCH 15, 2026. The Java House Grand Prix of Arlington will be an action-packed weekend in Arlington’s beloved Entertainment District with a street circuit that weaves around two famed venues recognized by sports fans across the globe: AT&T Stadium, home of the Dallas Cowboys, and Globe Life Field, home of the 2023 World Series-champion Texas Rangers. Latest News Kyle Kirkwood Outduels Champ To Win Arlington, Take Series Lead It’s been a long time since a rival driver made Alex Palou blink, but Kyle Kirkwood achieved that rare feat to win the inaugural Java House Grand Prix at Arlington on Sunday.
